items.titleZh: Adobe与阿尔派达成首个F1合作
items.summaryZh: 美国软件巨头Adobe在2026年美国大奖赛前宣布与阿尔派车队达成其首个F1合作，重点围绕车迷互动展开。Adobe高管Marissa Dacay表示，F1是最具数据驱动和性能驱动的运动，与Adobe高度契合。

media.altZh: Adobe与阿尔派达成首个F1合作 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: Why F1 is 'an incredible match’ for Adobe
items.summaryEn: US software giant Adobe announced its first F1 partnership with the Alpine team ahead of the 2026 United States Grand Prix, centred on fan engagement. Adobe global VP of enterprise marketing Marissa Dacay said F1 is the most data-driven and performance-driven sport, making it an incredible match for the company.
detailZh: 美国软件巨头Adobe在2026年美国大奖赛前宣布了其首个F1合作，称F1对Adobe而言是“绝佳的匹配”。
在奥斯汀由The Race与Axios共同举办的活动“Formula One's Premium Playbook”上，Adobe全球企业营销副总裁Marissa Dacay接受The Race首席执行官Fabricio Drumond采访时，解释了公司为何希望通过与阿尔派的新协议参与F1。
“没有哪项运动比F1更数据驱动、更性能驱动，”她说，“所以这对我们来说是绝佳的匹配，因为我们同样依靠数据、性能和创造力运转。”
“眼下也是运用技术的绝佳时机，想想F1，24场比赛、多种语言：大量的文化与细微差异。”
“在每个比赛周末、贯穿全年、以规模化方式、通过你们与车迷沟通的每一个渠道，你们要如何以个性化和具有文化细腻度的方式，去触达并对话你们的车迷？”
此次合作以推动车迷互动为核心，这家软件公司将为 阿尔派 部署其人工智能解决方案，以吸引受众与 阿尔派 互动。
Adobe GenStudio 将使 阿尔派 能够管理和策划面向全球车迷的营销活动，同时这支 F1 车队还将部署 Experience Platform 和 Brand Visibility。
与此同时，车迷将有机会在 阿尔派 未来开展的互动活动中使用 Adobe Express。
达卡伊表示，Adobe 与恩斯通F1车队有着“共同的愿景”。
“这对我们来说是一个全新的篇章。这是一项真正全球性的运动，这对我们非常重要。体育是连接技术、人文、创造力和文化的绝佳方式。
“因此，当我们寻找合作伙伴时，关键在于——我们如何拥有共同的愿景，即如何将这项运动或车队的表现、技术、创造力和人工智能融为一体，从而改变车迷与车队或这项运动互动的方式。
“此外，现在还有一个机会——车迷不再只是消费我们推送到他们面前的内容。他们希望参与到创作讲述故事的内容中来。
“他们想成为故事的主角。我认为，没有比我们自己的工具更好的工具，能帮助车迷参与车队活动，更近距离地感受到自己真正是这项运动中车队的一部分。”
达凯补充说，Adobe 的全套产品已经部署在大型体育营销活动中，而且其使用方式很多人并不了解。
“大家可能已经因为 PDF、Photoshop，以及 Adobe 四十多年来所做的所有事情而认识我们，”她说。
“没有多少人知道我们从事的是营销和客户体验编排业务。所以，当你使用车队应用、收到电子邮件，或者看到扑面而来的营销内容时，你所获得的许多个性化体验，很多都是由 Adobe 提供支持的。”
“因此，我们这里的机会在于超越人们所熟知的 Adobe 的创造力和文档类传统业务，并开始建立这样一种联系：当你与像 阿尔派 这样的品牌或像 阿尔派 这样的车队互动时，作为一名车迷你获得了绝佳的体验，而我们正是背后的支撑，让他们能够理解你和你的偏好。
“我们正是背后为你量身定制那一刻内容的力量。我们正是背后让你无论身处何地都能触达你的力量，无论是在手机上、电视上、应用上，还是在流媒体上。
“这正是我们希望在与体育的这些连接中去解锁的东西。”
detailEn: Formula 1 is an "incredible match" for US software giant Adobe, which announced its first F1 partnership in the lead-up to the 2026 United States Grand Prix.

Speaking to The Race CEO Fabricio Drumond at 'Formula One's Premium Playbook', an event hosted by The Race and Axios in Austin, Adobe’s global VP of enterprise marketing Marissa Dacay explained why the company wanted to get involved in F1 through its new deal with Alpine.

“There's no sport that's more data-driven, more performance-driven than Formula 1,” she said. “So it's just an incredible match for us, because we live through data and performance and creativity as well.
"Right now, it's an incredible time to use tech, too, if you think about F1, 24 races, multiple languages: tonnes of culture and nuance.

“How do you scale the way you're going to reach and speak to your fans in a personalised and culturally nuanced way, every weekend throughout the entire year, at scale, across every channel that you're speaking to your fans?”
The partnership is centred around driving fan engagement, with the software company to deploy its AI solutions to engage audiences with Alpine.
Adobe GenStudio will enable Alpine to manage and curate its marketing campaigns for fans around the world, with Experience Platform and Brand Visibility also set to be deployed by the F1 team.
Meanwhile, fans will be given the opportunity to use Adobe Express in forthcoming activations involving Alpine.
Dacay said Adobe has a “shared vision” with the Enstone F1 team.
“This one is a brand new chapter for us. It's a truly global sport, which is really important to us. Sports are such an amazing way to connect technology, humanity, creativity, culture.

“And so, when we're looking for a partner, it's - how do we have this shared vision about how we're bringing the performance of the sport or the team, technology, creativity, AI all together to change the way fans are going to engage with the team or with the sport.
“Also, there's an opportunity now - fans aren't just consuming the content that we're pushing out in front of them. They want to be part of creating the content that tells the story.

“They want to be the story. I think there's no better tools out there than our own to help fans participate with the team and get closer to actually feeling like they're part of the team in the sport.”
Dacay added that Adobe’s suite is already deployed in major sports marketing campaigns, and that it is used in ways that many people are unaware of.
“You all probably already know us for PDF, for Photoshop, for all the things that Adobe has done for over 40 years," she said.

“Not a lot of folks know that we're in the marketing, customer experience orchestration business. So a lot of the personalised experiences that you get when you're engaging with an app for the team, or you're receiving an email, or you're seeing marketing just out hitting you, a lot of that is powered by Adobe.

“So the opportunity we have here is to go beyond the creativity and document kind of heritage that you know Adobe for, and start to build the connection that when you engage with a brand like Alpine or a team like Alpine, and you have an incredible experience as a fan, we're behind why they understand you and your preferences.
"We're behind the content that was customised for you in that moment. We're behind reaching you wherever you are, whether it's on the phone, on TV, on an app, on streaming.
"That's the thing that we're looking to unlock in these connections with sports.”
keyPointsZh: Adobe将向阿尔派部署Adobe GenStudio、Experience Platform和Brand Visibility，用于管理和策划面向全球车迷的营销活动
车迷将在未来与阿尔派相关的活动中获得使用Adobe Express的机会
Dacay提到F1全年24场比赛、多语言环境带来大量文化差异，需要以个性化方式触达车迷
keyPointsEn: Adobe will deploy Adobe GenStudio, Experience Platform and Brand Visibility with Alpine to manage and curate marketing campaigns for fans worldwide.
Fans will be given the opportunity to use Adobe Express in forthcoming activations involving Alpine.
Dacay cited F1's 24 races and multiple languages as bringing tonnes of culture and nuance, requiring a personalised way to reach fans.

items.originalTitle: Belgian firm to take over Renault/Alpine engine facility in Viry
items.summaryEn: Renault has agreed to sell its Viry-Chatillon engine facility to Belgian company Dumarey Group, and the acquisition proposal has already been submitted to Alpine Racing.
detailZh: 比利时公司接手雷诺/阿尔派位于Viry的引擎工厂
在缩减F1引擎项目后，雷诺已为Viry工厂找到买家
Viry-Chatillon雷诺工厂鸟瞰图
雷诺已同意将位于Viry-Chatillon的引擎工厂出售给比利时公司Dumarey集团。
根据一份官方声明，专注于量产车辆动力总成及工程部件技术与开发的杜马雷集团，已准备接管该法国厂区。
该收购提案已提交给阿尔派车队。双方目前正积极推进对整个组织及其财务层面的全面分析，目标是确定如何快速推进后续工作。
根据该交易，杜马雷集团将收购位于维里-沙蒂永的 阿尔派 Racing SAS，包括“运营该厂区所需的团队以及有形和无形资产”。
维里位于巴黎南郊，数十年来一直是雷诺一级方程式引擎项目的所在地，并被视为法国赛车运动的重要枢纽。
但雷诺在去年年底关闭了其内部引擎部门，转而让 阿尔派 与梅赛德斯签署客户协议，这威胁到了维里数百名员工的未来。
阿尔派 也将在今年年底退出世界耐力锦标赛，此前该公司利用维里来维护和组装为其 A424 LMDh 赛车提供动力的 Mecachrome 制造引擎。
#35 阿尔派 耐力车队 阿尔派 A424：安东尼奥·费利克斯·达科斯塔、费迪南德·哈布斯堡、查尔斯·米莱西
该协议还可能对 阿尔派 的 Hypercar 项目产生影响，其工厂合作伙伴 Signatech 希望在 2027 年以不同品牌运营 A424。
在上个月的富士6小时耐力赛之后，Signatech似乎已准备与中国品牌吉利敲定协议，但两家公司之间的谈判似乎已经破裂。
2027赛季的报名截止日期是11月25日；必须在此前完成必要的正式文件，以确保获得Hypercar组别的席位。数周以来，车队负责人菲利普·西诺一直坚称，在工程师、机械师以及明年继续在锦标赛中推进A424项目所需的所有其他资源方面，一切均已就绪。
自然，组建一支新车队也需要签下必要的车手（例如注意到安东尼奥·菲利克斯·达科斯塔的离队），并确认已经参与该项目的车手。
杜马雷集团在声明中强调，其“正寻求将业务多元化拓展至赛车运动”，并表示该交易“为未来利用雷诺的一级方程式引擎专长为赛车队创造机会”。
阿尔派 Tech 副总裁阿克塞尔·普拉斯表示：“这笔交易是一个有力且连贯的机会，可以保障并进一步发展维里-沙蒂永基地的专业能力。它为员工和工程业务开辟了新的前景。这一发展是对该基地长期赛车运动专业能力的认可，尤其是在一级方程式方面。”
detailEn: Belgian firm to take over Renault/Alpine engine facility in Viry
Renault has secured a buyer for its Viry factory after curtailing its F1 engine programme
Aerial view of the Renault factory at Viry-Châtillon
Renault has agreed to sell its Viry-Chatillon engine facility to Belgian company Dumarey Group.

According to an official statement, the Dumarey Group, which specialises in technology and development of powertrains and engineering components for mass-produced vehicles, is prepared to take control of the French site.

The acquisition proposal has already been submitted to Alpine Racing. Both parties are now working diligently to analyse the entire organization and its financial aspects, with the goal of determining how to move forward quickly.
The deal will see Dumarey Group acquire Alpine Racing SAS, located in Viry-Chatillon, including "the teams and the tangible and intangible assets required to operate the site".
Located in the southern suburbs of Paris, Viry was the home of Renault's Formula 1 engine programme for several decades and was seen as an important hub for motorsport in France.

But Renault pulled the plug on its in-house engine department at the end of last year in favour of Alpine signing a customer deal with Mercedes, threatening the future of hundreds of employees at Viry.
Alpine is also exiting the World Endurance Championship at the end of the year, having used Viry to maintain and assemble the Mecachrome-built engines that power its A424 LMDhs.
#35 Alpine Endurance Team Alpine A424: Antonio Felix Da Costa, Ferdinand Habsburg, Charles Milesi
The deal could also have implications for Alpine's Hypercar programme, with its factory partner Signatech keen to run the A424 under a different brand in 2027.
Signatech appeared poised to finalise a deal with Chinese brand Geely after last month's Fuji 6 Hours, but the talks between the two firms appear to have broken down.

The deadline for entry into the 2027 season is 25 November; the necessary formal documentation must be finalised by then to secure a spot in the Hypercar class. For weeks, team principal Philippe Sinault has maintained that everything is in place, in terms of engineers, mechanics and all other resources required, to continue the A424 program in the championship next year.
Naturally, organising a new team also entails signing the necessary drivers (noting, for instance, the departure of Antonio Felix da Costa) and confirming those already involved in the programme.

In its statement, the Dumarey Group stressed that it is "seeking to diversify its activities into motorsport", saying the deal "creates opportunities to leverage Renault's Formula 1 engine expertise for racing teams in the future".

Axel Plasse, VP Alpine Tech, said: “This transaction represents a strong and coherent opportunity to secure and further develop the expertise of the Viry-Châtillon site. It opens up new prospects for employees and for the engineering business. This development is a recognition of the site’s longstanding motorsport expertise, particularly in Formula 1.”
keyPointsZh: Dumarey集团专注于量产车的动力总成及工程零部件技术与开发
此次出售发生在雷诺缩减其F1引擎项目之后
keyPointsEn: Dumarey Group specialises in technology and development of powertrains and engineering components for mass-produced vehicles
The sale follows Renault's curtailment of its F1 engine programme
